C1136.title: Huizhou Police Uncover a USDT Running-Man Scheme
C1136.summary: A 2021 article by the Tencent Financial Technology Research Institute, citing police information, reported that police in Huizhou, Guangdong, uncovered a USDT running-man scheme in June 2020. Preliminary findings said the platform had operated for nearly 15 months, settling funds for 120 overseas gambling websites and 70 investment-fraud platforms and handling 120 million yuan; participants used USDT as collateral and for settlement.

references.title: Lin Haifeng: Monitoring practices and suggestions for virtual currency money laundering risks
